{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check: how many unique patients remain?
num_patients = len(df_dedup)
print('Number of unique patients after deduplication:', num_patients)

# Now compute the fraction with severe baseline disease
count_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = count_severe / num_patients
print(f'Number with severe baseline disease: {count_severe}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe:.4f}')"}
